capabilities.title: The foundation now reflects the product we are actually building.
capabilities.description: The shell now communicates forecasting, data quality, explainability, and operator value instead of reading like a starter template.

items.title: Stock trend prediction
items.description: Frame directional moves with scenario-ready forecasts, confidence ranges, and a path toward model review surfaces.

items.title: Currency value analysis
items.description: Track FX pairs with relative-strength context, macro factor overlays, and future workstation hooks for cross-market analysis.

items.title: Signal engineering
items.description: Keep feature logic pure and reusable so technical, event, and macro signals can evolve without leaking into UI layers.

items.title: Explainable forecasts
items.description: Surface the factors behind a forecast so analysts can inspect why the system leans bullish, cautious, or defensive.

items.title: Ingestion observability
items.description: Treat freshness, canonicalization, and provider health as first-class product states rather than hidden backend details.

items.title: Decision support shell
items.description: Create a semantic application frame that can grow into dashboard, admin, and workflow-specific product surfaces.

modules.title: A reusable entry frame for every surface we know is coming.
modules.description: These module cards establish a stable navigation and content grammar for future route-level work without overbuilding the component library today.

items.title: Trend monitoring workspace
items.description: Longer-horizon equity monitoring with regime shifts, factor contribution views, and forecast comparisons.

items.title: Currency intelligence surface
items.description: Pair-level valuation, momentum snapshots, and macro-aware commentary shells for future analyst workflows.

items.title: Feature registry
items.description: A home for technical, macro, and event-derived features with traceable provenance and validation status.

items.title: Freshness and source health
items.description: Operational visibility into source coverage, canonicalization steps, and recomputation triggers.

explainability.title: Forecast outputs should always be inspectable.
explainability.description: This shell creates room for evidence trails, scenario deltas, and model confidence commentary without smuggling forecasting behavior into the UI.

flow.title: Ingest and canonicalize
flow.description: Providers and background jobs land raw market data, then normalize it into durable, query-friendly contracts.

flow.title: Engineer features
flow.description: Pure analytics packages generate reusable signals so forecast quality does not depend on route-level code.

flow.title: Score and explain
flow.description: Forecasting produces directional output plus feature-level reasoning that can later feed analyst review panels.

flow.title: Render operator context
flow.description: The web shell presents system status, explainability summaries, and decision-ready navigation without owning the analytics logic.

simulation.statusError: Observation feed is unavailable. Trading is read-only.
simulation.statusDegraded: Observation feed is degraded. Trading is read-only until freshness recovers.
